faq: What is Ashish Dhawan's portfolio worth?
His publicly disclosed holdings were about ₹2,128–2,177 crore across 13 stocks after the September 2026 filings, depending on the price date used.
What did Ashish Dhawan buy recently?
New stakes in the September 2026 quarter include Equitas Small Finance Bank (4.10%) and Allcargo Global (1.00%), and he raised his Religare Enterprises stake by 2.09 points to 7.33%.
How has his Bluspring bet done?
He bought 17 lakh Bluspring shares at ₹45.55 on 23 March 2026. At about ₹153 in November 2026, that lot was up roughly 236% on paper, an estimated gain of about ₹18 crore.
How do you know the prices?
Prices are exact only for bulk and block deals, which the exchanges publish daily. Quarterly filings show shares held but not the price paid, so those gains are shown as not public or estimated.
